case.summary: The alert was triggered when customer C09988 reported a $59.67 online purchase (transaction 3534820) that they said they never made. The strongest findings are that 13 other cards made online purchases of the same amount and product C within 1 % of $59.67 using a hotmail.com email address, and seven of those cards share the same time-delta feature D15 = 21, indicating a single actor behind multiple cards; additionally, every similar customer-reported alert in the bank's closed cases was confirmed as fraud. The case was judged to be fraud with a probability of 0.95. The recommended actions are to block the card, create a new case, file a report, and monitor the connected cards.

sar.narrative: The cardholder identified as customer C09988, using visa debit card C09988-K1, reported a disputed transaction to the bank and denied making it. On 2016-12-11 at 22:39:08, an online purchase of $59.67 was processed on product code C from billing region 0. The transaction originated from a Windows device using the Edge 16.0 browser, a device profile not previously associated with the cardholder. The purchase was inconsistent with the cardholder's typical behavior and matched a fixed-amount purchase template ($59.67, product C, email hotmail.com, time-delta feature D15 = 21) observed on thirteen other cards. Seven of those cards share the same time-delta feature, indicating a common actor behind multiple card numbers. The pattern was classified as card-not-present activity on a new device, and the bank's prior closed cases show that similar customer-reported alerts were confirmed fraud. Consequently, the card was blocked, a case was created, a suspicious activity report was filed, and connected cards were placed under monitoring.
